name: @peek/desktop
description: Peek desktop — Electron main process, renderer, features, and packaging.

scripts.build: ../../scripts/timed.sh sh -c 'node ../../packages/schema/codegen.js && tsc -p tsconfig.json && cp -r main/chrome-api-polyfills dist/main/ && node ../../scripts/patch-chrome-extensions.js'
scripts.build:electron:install: cd ../.. && ./scripts/timed.sh sh -c 'yarn workspace @peek/desktop build && electron-builder --dir && rm -rf /Applications/Peek.app && cp -R out/mac-arm64/Peek.app /Applications/'
scripts.build:electron:install:linux: cd ../.. && ./scripts/timed.sh sh -c 'yarn workspace @peek/desktop build && electron-builder && mkdir -p ~/Applications && cp out/Peek-*.AppImage ~/Applications/Peek.AppImage && chmod +x ~/Applications/Peek.AppImage && echo "installed: ~/Applications/Peek.AppImage (launch once to install ~/.local/bin/peek)"'
scripts.build:electron:install:linux:test: cd ../.. && ./scripts/timed.sh sh -c 'yarn workspace @peek/desktop build && electron-builder && mkdir -p ~/Applications && cp out/Peek-*.AppImage ~/Applications/Peek-test.AppImage && chmod +x ~/Applications/Peek-test.AppImage && echo "installed: ~/Applications/Peek-test.AppImage (side-by-side, does NOT replace prod). To exercise the cli-alias without touching ~/.local/bin/peek, launch with PEEK_CLI_ALIAS_DIR=<test-dir> ~/Applications/Peek-test.AppImage"'
scripts.dev: ../../scripts/timed.sh sh -c 'yarn check:native && yarn build && cd ../.. && DEBUG=1 electron .'
scripts.dev:hot: yarn build && nodemon --exec 'yarn build && cd ../.. && DEBUG=1 electron .'
scripts.start: ../../scripts/timed.sh sh -c 'yarn check:native && yarn build && cd ../.. && electron .'
scripts.test:desktop:electron:source: cd ../.. && ./scripts/timed.sh sh -c 'node scripts/check-native-modules.js && yarn workspace @peek/desktop build && HEADLESS=1 BACKEND=electron ./scripts/playwright-with-display.sh test --config apps/desktop/playwright.config.ts --project=desktop && HEADLESS=1 BACKEND=electron ./scripts/playwright-with-display.sh test --config apps/desktop/playwright.config.ts --project=desktop-serial --workers=1'
scripts.test:desktop:electron:x: cd ../.. && ./scripts/timed.sh sh -c 'yarn workspace @peek/desktop build && electron-builder --dir && HEADLESS=1 PACKAGED=1 BACKEND=electron ./scripts/playwright-with-display.sh test --config apps/desktop/playwright.config.ts apps/desktop/tests/desktop/ -x'
scripts.test:packaged: cd ../.. && yarn kill:packaged && HEADLESS=1 PACKAGED=1 ./scripts/playwright-with-display.sh test --config apps/desktop/playwright.config.ts --project=desktop
scripts.test:packaged:debug: cd ../.. && yarn kill:packaged && HEADLESS=1 PACKAGED=1 DEBUG=1 ./scripts/playwright-with-display.sh test --config apps/desktop/playwright.config.ts --project=desktop
scripts.test:default-browser:linux: cd ../.. && ./scripts/timed.sh sh -c 'yarn workspace @peek/desktop build && yarn workspace @peek/desktop build:electron:dist && ./scripts/smoke-default-browser.sh'
scripts.test:unit: ../../scripts/timed.sh sh -c 'yarn build && NODE_ENV=test ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE=1 npx electron --test dist/main/*.test.js && NODE_ENV=test node --test tests/unit/*.test.js'
scripts.test:unit:modes: ../../scripts/timed.sh sh -c 'yarn build && ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE=1 npx electron --test dist/main/modes.test.js'
scripts.test:unit:shortcuts: ../../scripts/timed.sh sh -c 'yarn build && ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE=1 npx electron --test dist/main/shortcuts.test.js'
scripts.test:unit:datastore: ../../scripts/timed.sh sh -c 'yarn build && ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE=1 npx electron --test dist/main/datastore.test.js'
scripts.test:visible: ../../scripts/timed.sh sh -c 'yarn build && cd ../.. && HEADLESS=0 BACKEND=electron npx playwright test --config apps/desktop/playwright.config.ts apps/desktop/tests/desktop/ --headed'
scripts.test:debug: ../../scripts/timed.sh sh -c 'yarn build && cd ../.. && HEADLESS=0 npx playwright test --debug'
scripts.test:grep: ../../scripts/timed.sh sh -c 'yarn build && cd ../.. && HEADLESS=1 BACKEND=electron ./scripts/playwright-with-display.sh test --config apps/desktop/playwright.config.ts apps/desktop/tests/desktop/ --grep "$0"'
scripts.test:desktop:electron:grep: cd ../.. && HEADLESS=1 PACKAGED=1 BACKEND=electron ./scripts/playwright-with-display.sh test --config apps/desktop/playwright.config.ts apps/desktop/tests/desktop/ --reporter=line --grep "$0"
scripts.test:desktop:electron:spec: cd ../.. && HEADLESS=1 PACKAGED=1 BACKEND=electron ./scripts/playwright-with-display.sh test --config apps/desktop/playwright.config.ts --reporter=line "$0"
scripts.harness: ../../scripts/timed.sh sh -c 'yarn build && cd ../.. && BACKEND=electron HEADLESS=0 npx playwright test --config apps/desktop/playwright.config.ts --project=manual --workers=1 --headed'
scripts.debug:headless: ../../scripts/timed.sh sh -c 'yarn build && cd ../.. && PEEK_HEADLESS=1 DEBUG=1 electron .'
scripts.debug:electron:headless: ../../scripts/timed.sh sh -c 'yarn build && cd ../.. && PEEK_HEADLESS=1 DEBUG=1 electron .'
scripts.debug:electron:log: cd ../.. && yarn kill:electron && sleep 1 && yarn workspace @peek/desktop build && DEBUG=1 electron . 2>&1 | tee /tmp/electron-debug.log
scripts.debug:electron:bg: cd ../.. && yarn kill:electron && sleep 1 && yarn workspace @peek/desktop build && DEBUG=1 electron . > /tmp/electron-debug.log 2>&1 &
scripts.run:packaged: cd ../.. && ./scripts/timed.sh sh -c 'yarn workspace @peek/desktop kill:packaged && yarn workspace @peek/desktop build && electron-builder --dir && PROFILE=tmp-$(date +%s) out/mac-arm64/Peek.app/Contents/MacOS/Peek'
scripts.run:packaged:check: cd ../.. && yarn workspace @peek/desktop kill:packaged && out/mac-arm64/Peek.app/Contents/MacOS/Peek 2>&1 | head -5 && sleep 2 && yarn workspace @peek/desktop kill:packaged
scripts.lint:test-honesty:changed: cd ../.. && node scripts/lint-test-honesty.mjs --changed main apps/desktop/main apps/desktop/tests/unit
scripts.test:desktop:electron: cd ../.. && ./scripts/timed.sh sh -c 'node scripts/check-native-modules.js && node scripts/lint-test-honesty.mjs --changed main apps/desktop/main apps/desktop/tests/unit && yarn workspace @peek/desktop build && electron-builder --dir && ( fail=0; NODE_ENV=test ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE=1 npx electron --test apps/desktop/dist/main/*.test.js || fail=1; NODE_ENV=test node --test apps/desktop/tests/unit/*.test.js || fail=1; HEADLESS=1 PACKAGED=1 BACKEND=electron ./scripts/playwright-with-display.sh test --config apps/desktop/playwright.config.ts --project=desktop || fail=1; HEADLESS=1 PACKAGED=1 BACKEND=electron ./scripts/playwright-with-display.sh test --config apps/desktop/playwright.config.ts --project=desktop-serial --workers=1 || fail=1; HEADLESS=1 BACKEND=electron ./scripts/playwright-with-display.sh test --config apps/desktop/playwright.config.ts --project=components || fail=1; HEADLESS=1 BACKEND=electron ./scripts/playwright-with-display.sh test --config apps/desktop/playwright.config.ts --project=editor || fail=1; exit $fail )'
